verdict.rationale: The firm publishes an EMI factsheet (UK) and a German-specific Term Sheet Generator tool, showing genuine jurisdiction-specific startup-instrument content for at least two markets, but there is no evidence of coverage for French BSPCE or Indian FDI/ESOP rules. missing for 10: French BSPCE-specific publications, Indian FDI/ESOP-specific publications, deeper VSOP-specific German content beyond the term sheet tool.
